note_on_scope: Catalogue addition, same as Galatasaray -- TOBB ETU has no existing universities row.

proposed_university_row.name: TOBB University of Economics and Technology
proposed_university_row.website_url_note: Both www and bare etu.edu.tr resolve cleanly (200, valid cert) -- no cert-chain issue like Galatasaray's www subdomain. Cert is domain-validated (Sectigo DV, CN=*.etu.edu.tr) rather than organization-validated, so identity was confirmed by live page content (address, navigation, programme names matching YÖK Atlas exactly) rather than by certificate subject the way Galatasaray's OV cert allowed.

programs_source.note: 22 distinct programmes, deduplicated from 62 raw YOK Atlas LISANS records -- each programme appears as up to 3 separate placement records (Burslu/full scholarship, %50 İndirimli/half tuition, Ücretli/full tuition), matching how university_program_placement_cycles.burs_orani_adi already models this for the existing 12 universities. Two programmes (Tarih, Türk Dili ve Edebiyatı) show only a single Burslu-tier record each in the live data -- scholarship-only admission routes, not a data gap; not independently confirmed against the university's own site this pass.

placement_signal_summary.note: Aggregate only this pass, not all 62 individual placement-cycle rows -- see the handoff doc for why.
placement_signal_summary.spread_finding: The same underlying programme spans an enormous selectivity range depending on fee tier -- e.g. İktisat: rank 838 on the Burslu (scholarship) seat vs rank 818,411 on the Ücretli (full-price) seat. This is the real shape of a mid-size vakif university's selectivity: a small number of genuinely elite, free seats per programme, and a much larger number of full-price seats reachable by nearly any YKS candidate. A single 'best rank' number (188, used in this project's own candidate-list ranking) is accurate but describes only the scholarship tier, not the institution as a whole -- worth keeping in mind when this university's overall selectivity is discussed with a student who may or may not be scholarship-eligible.

domestic_admission_facts.mechanism: Same as every other Turkish university: YKS placement in rank order per programme+tier quota. lib/admissions/system-shape.ts's existing Turkey/domestic entry covers this correctly, no override needed.
domestic_admission_facts.distinguishing_fact: Fee-tier structure (Burslu/%50 İndirimli/Ücretli) is the operative 'requirement' variation for a domestic applicant here, not anything evaluative -- which tier a placement lands in is entirely a function of YKS rank, already captured in the placement-cycle data above, not a separate requirements fact.

international_pathway_facts.finding: A real, structured international-application portal exists (dated application windows, tuition/scholarship info, a required-documents page), but the specific entrance-exam-vs-standardized-test-score question was not resolved this pass -- the answer sits on a linked subpage not fetched. Left unresolved rather than guessed, unlike Galatasaray where the answer (GSÜYÖS) was found directly.

explicitly_not_established: Whether TOBB ETU requires its own entrance exam for foreign-national applicants, or accepts SAT/A-Level/IB/Abitur/diploma scores directly
